description: Source code for a Drupal block plugin class 'BlockContentBlock' that defines a content block type, including methods for configuration, access control, rendering, and entity loading.

classes.name: BlockContentBlock
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class defining a content block type with configuration, access, and rendering logic.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the block, setting 'view_mode' to 'full'.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Builds the block configuration form, allowing selection of view mode.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the block configuration form, updating view mode and clearing cache.

methods.name: blockAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view the block.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Renders the block content or provides a link to add content if none exists.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Indicates that the block can be used as a placeholder.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Loads and returns the block content entity associated with this block.
